topics.title: Weekly volume landmarks
topics.body:
Signal tracks weekly hard sets per muscle against MEV and MRV landmarks.

Each mesocycle ramps volume toward the upper bound, then schedules a deload before resetting the block. Landmarks refine from logged tolerance over time.

This is coaching guidance, not medical advice.

topics.title: Movement selection
topics.body:
Exercises are ranked by effectiveness, stretch-position bias, and stimulus-to-fatigue for the target muscle.

Equipment preferences and selection bias below change which movement wins when more than one option is available.

Citations in the seed library are placeholders until Cameron authors the final references.

topics.title: Readiness autoregulation
topics.body:
Your morning ARC score scales today's prescribed sets and caps target RPE when recovery is low.

Peaking readiness keeps the planned top-end work in place. The engine always renders numbers offline; the coach narrates the why when online.

topics.title: Deloads and resets
topics.body:
Deload weeks trim volume across the block before landmarks reset for the next accumulation phase.

Missed sessions are handled by the drift policy so the plan stays on route without manual spreadsheet work.
